ActorReference.description: Server-authored record, never an external credential.
ActorReference.title: ActorReference

CanonicalCase.description: Provider-neutral representation of one appraisal review case.
CanonicalCase.title: CanonicalCase

CaseConditionCandidate.description: A source-backed proposed condition, never an assertion of applicability.
CaseConditionCandidate.title: CaseConditionCandidate

CaseContextView.description:
Exact current material metadata; selection is not confirmation or approval.

The exact semantic snapshot is required. No source path, raw material payload,
principal roster or future deployment region is exposed. Document purposes are
preserved, not inferred as general rules, district prices or report templates.
CaseContextView.title: CaseContextView

ConvertedPDFArtifact.description: A PDF converted from one exact workbook copy, which it names.
ConvertedPDFArtifact.title: ConvertedPDFArtifact

DocumentReference.description: External identity: no caller-selected storage URI or asserted authority.
DocumentReference.title: DocumentReference

EntryProblemResponse.description: The same JSON envelope used by HTTP and direct invocation.
EntryProblemResponse.title: EntryProblemResponse

EvidenceRef.description: Location and confidence for a value found in a source document.
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

ExportBasis.description:
Everything a client needs to compose a valid export request, served, not guessed.

The page must not invent the snapshot digest or the template bundle: both identify
server-held state, and a wrong guess turns into a confusing conflict. This view hands
them over for the job's current run, together with the snapshot's open gaps so the
format chooser can show what a draft will still be missing.
ExportBasis.title: ExportBasis

ExportOperation.description: Immutable format plus the current state of one export request.
ExportOperation.title: ExportOperation

ExportRequest.description: An untrusted command. Eligibility for formal output is decided by the server.
ExportRequest.title: ExportRequest

ExtractedField.description: A normalized field that retains its original representation.
ExtractedField.title: ExtractedField

FencedArtifactManifest.description:
Versioned public projection of a committed, possibly multi-context PDF.

The original service-v1 local-only artifact remains unchanged. A consumer
must explicitly support this version before accepting a fenced publication.
FencedArtifactManifest.title: FencedArtifactManifest

HumanResponse.description: Untrusted command: principal/roles and approval flags are not accepted.
HumanResponse.title: HumanResponse

JobAcceptance.description:
202 body: acceptance of durable responsibility, never a result or a claim of work.

job_status is pinned so this body can never advertise progress that has not happened.
An idempotent replay of an already-known submission returns JobStatusView instead.
JobAcceptance.title: JobAcceptance

JobReference.description: External job identity. Never carries a queue name, table name or worker identity.
JobReference.title: JobReference

JobStatus.description: Durable control-plane status; never interchangeable with wire ExecutionStatus.
JobStatus.title: JobStatus

JobStatusView.description: Authorized status projection: no storage URI, lease owner or dispatch token.
JobStatusView.title: JobStatusView

message.const: PDF output failed; review findings remain available.
message.default: PDF output failed; review findings remain available.
message.title: Message

PDFValueRef.description: Explicit binding; field_id is a placement ID, never an expression.
PDFValueRef.title: PDFValueRef

PausedReviewView.description: An exact stored human-handoff assessment, never a committed or published result.
PausedReviewView.title: PausedReviewView

PublicValue-Input.description: URI-free view of an original/proposed value; never a trusted fact input.
PublicValue-Input.title: PublicValue

PublicValue-Output.description: URI-free view of an original/proposed value; never a trusted fact input.
PublicValue-Output.title: PublicValue

ResponseReceipt.description:
What one accepted response actually committed. Never an approval or a review result.

The receipt is the idempotent body: an exact replay of the same principal, key and
payload returns this same value, so a reviewer who retries a lost response can tell
that their answer landed once rather than twice.
ResponseReceipt.title: ResponseReceipt

originating_field_ids.description: Exact source-evidence blocker IDs from this review's inventory, sorted and unique.
originating_field_ids.title: Originating Field Ids

ReviewSessionView.description: The currently authenticated actor, not a registration or permission grant.
ReviewSessionView.title: ReviewSessionView

ReviewSubmission.description: Reserved jobs request; no jobs route or durable implementation in M0.
ReviewSubmission.title: ReviewSubmission

RevisionListView.description:
The revision chain this job produced, oldest first and explicitly linked.

The order is part of the contract: a consumer reconstructing what a reviewer changed
must not have to re-sort by a timestamp the service does not publish.
RevisionListView.title: RevisionListView

RuleBundleView.description: Selected, authorized sources only; the full internal catalog stays private.
RuleBundleView.title: RuleBundleView

message.const: Service operation could not be completed.
message.default: Service operation could not be completed.
message.title: Message

ServiceVerification.description: Sanitized projection of the existing verification report, including preflight.
ServiceVerification.title: ServiceVerification

TableOutcome.description: Per-table result, so a partial export says which table is missing and why.
TableOutcome.title: TableOutcome

TaskListView.description:
The tasks of one job the caller may act on, ordered oldest first.

Superseded tasks stay listed: a reviewer who is holding a stale task page needs to be
able to discover that it was superseded, rather than to see it silently disappear.
TaskListView.title: TaskListView

TaskSubjectView.description:
Exact stored value and input requirements; a separate opt-in projection.

Keeping this out of TaskView preserves the frozen legacy response shape.
A client must never infer a measurement unit from a factor name.
TaskSubjectView.title: TaskSubjectView

TaskView.description:
One task plus the names a client would otherwise have to re-derive to answer it.

`subject_id` is the ledger name of the observation the task is about. It is published
rather than left to the caller because deriving it means canonicalizing the comparison
context, and two languages do not canonicalize alike: Python's json.dumps escapes
non-ASCII by default and JavaScript's JSON.stringify does not, so a browser would
compute a different name for any case whose identifiers are not ASCII. Every identifier
in this project's real cases is Chinese.
TaskView.title: TaskView

TemplateBundleReference.description: A pinned official asset bundle. A request names it; it never carries a path.
TemplateBundleReference.title: TemplateBundleReference

VerificationDiagnostic.description: Finite public reasons; never carry raw internal verification messages.

enum: Requested documents must match the configured review sources.
A current source registry is required to review the material.
Verification could not pass; inspect review findings or request human review.
Verification reported a warning; request human review before proceeding.
message.title: Message

VerificationDiagnostic.title: VerificationDiagnostic

WorkbookArtifact.description: A filled copy of the official workbook, with the cells the writer was allowed.
WorkbookArtifact.title: WorkbookArtifact

info.description: Synchronous factor review entry; document extraction requires configuration.
info.title: Agentic AI Real Estate Valuation Reviewer

An exact replay returns 200 with the job's real status, because reporting the pinned
acceptance for a job that has already moved on would be a fabricated response.
